answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: each agent locks a small deposit that grows with every honest attestation, like a harbor that only shelters ships which have weathered real storms. A public lantern log makes every attestation visible, so fake identities cannot hide in the dark. And a ridge of escalating costs — each new identity pays more than the last — makes spawning thousands of sock puppets pointless, since faking costs more than any reward.
